paired_cue.pairing: Motion schedules, dots, nuisance draws and all pixels outside the union of the two valid cue rings are identical.
paired_cue.interpretation: Changing only the valid cue altered routing and the predicted class in 15/32 paired movies, demonstrating cue sensitivity in the frozen baseline. Accuracy and correct-class probability remained near chance, so this does not demonstrate successful use of the cue-duration rule.

sensory_probe.representation: Frozen final moving-frame 64-channel sensory field, local 3x3 mean at each patch center before global pooling.
sensory_probe.split_control: Independent base episodes by split, train-only standardization and validation-only ridge selection.
sensory_probe.interpretation: Held-out linear decoding is effectively at chance, providing no evidence that this particular local final-frame feature summary exposes longest-duration direction. Probe failure does not establish absence from all sensory states or nonlinear representations.

immutability: The checkpoint SHA256 was verified before and after diagnostics; no model weights were updated.
